title: lathyrus occidentalis subsp. scopolii
intro: Lathyrus occidentalis subsp. scopolii, commonly known as the Western sweetpea or Scopolia sweetpea, is a flowering plant species native to the western United States. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support the nervous system and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia due to its sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus occidentalis subsp. scopolii include its use as a sedative, antispasmodic, and anxiolytic agent, attributed to the presence of bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
